description: Receives authenticated Pebble ring events and delivers their sanitized metadata and transcript to the CodeTerm General Agent.
configHelp: Requires CodeTerm 1.10.20+ with multipart webhook support and the Pebble setup view. Open the Pebble view to see the current machine's webhook URL and pebble_webhook_secret, then put that URL and Authorization: Bearer <token> into CoreApp. Select Transcription only and let CoreApp generate Content-Type with its multipart boundary. HTTP 415 means the host or media type is wrong.
